# GitHub Pages publish list for SWOT Builder.
# Only the paths listed here become public. See docs/patterns/github-pages-deploy.md
# in the team repository for the format. Any change to this file changes what is
# public and needs security review.
#
# SWOT Builder is an unbundled Babel Standalone app: its runtime files sit at the
# repository root, plus fonts/ and assets/.

/colors_and_type.css
/swot-styles.css
/theme.js
/swot-app.jsx
/swot-board.jsx
/swot-engine.jsx
/swot-engine-core.js
/swot-interview.jsx
/swot-intro.jsx
/tweaks-panel.jsx
/models.json
/fonts/
/assets/
